text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Air Groove after her
magnificent run in the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Should I say, as expected of the 'Oka Sho'? Everyone I ran with was a magnificent rival."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why—
my heart dances at this challenge.

Even though she had just finished running, Air Groove
was burning with an even hotter fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're heading back at once. Based on today's race,
we need to rethink our strategy for the Oaks.

Our next battle, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), is right around the corner—
There's no time to slack off!
